prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about primes lighting up on a spiral grid. Around 90 BPM, D Dorian. Kalimba walks a regular grid; muted piano strikes only on irregular steps, like primes. Curious, stepwise, patterned without being a groove track. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No trap hats, no bass drop.

[00:00–00:20] Kalimba on a pentatonic grid, even steps.
[00:20–01:00] Muted piano dots appear off-grid; analog clicks mark the spiral's corners.
[01:00–01:45] Soft bass holds D; irregular piano density increases, still never a drum loop.
[01:45–02:30] Grid remains; piano dots thin, revealing the spiral as afterimage.
